journalStates.PREPARE: durable journal exists after backup and temp candidate have independently verified; target still expected original
journalStates.REPLACE_READY: all pre-replace gates passed; final source recheck and atomic replace are next
journalStates.REPLACED: atomic replacement plus parent-directory fsync completed; post-commit verification still required
journalStates.COMMITTED: target is exact verified candidate; exact backup retained
journalStates.ABORTED: replacement did not produce committed candidate; target is exact original or an external pre-replace source change caused fail-closed abort
journalStates.RECOVERY_REQUIRED: automatic completion/rollback did not safely close; writes blocked until explicit recovery
journalStates.ROLLED_BACK: exact backup was atomically restored and reverified

recoveryPolicy.PREPARE: prefer exact original; remove temp; mark ABORTED
recoveryPolicy.REPLACE_READY: if target exact candidate, verify and COMMIT; if target exact original, ABORT; otherwise exact-backup rollback
recoveryPolicy.REPLACED: if target exact candidate, verify and COMMIT; if target exact original, ROLLED_BACK; otherwise rollback
recoveryPolicy.RECOVERY_REQUIRED: exact candidate -> COMMIT if independently valid; exact original -> ROLLED_BACK; other -> exact-backup rollback
recoveryPolicy.COMMITTED: idempotently verify candidate + backup; exact original is treated as ROLLED_BACK; unexpected bytes require rollback/recovery
recoveryPolicy.staleLock: recovery only; lock integrity must pass, host must match, recorded PID must be dead, then recovery reclaims lock
recoveryPolicy.journalIntegrity: SHA-256 over canonical journal excluding integrity field; tamper fails closed
recoveryPolicy.interruptedTemp: never authoritative; target original/candidate + journal decide recovery
recoveryPolicy.preJournalStaleLock: dead same-host PID + integrity-valid deterministically bound lock + no journal + exact original target => reclaim lock, discard non-authoritative temp, retain exact backup, ABORTED; live/foreign/binding-mismatched lock fails closed
recoveryPolicy.missingTarget: journal-backed recovery treats a missing target as non-authoritative and restores the exact verified backup through the same sibling-temp/rename/fsync path
recoveryPolicy.pathBinding: journal paths are re-derived from caller target path + caller backup directory + transaction id + source hash; self-rehashed path redirection is rejected
recoveryPolicy.integrityBoundary: journal SHA-256 detects accidental corruption; recovery also semantically rebinds build/runtime/candidate/plan and deterministic paths. This is not a keyed anti-malicious signature.

backupLifecycle.naming: target basename + transaction id + source-hash prefix; never overwrite existing backup
